Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack is sitting on a bed, staring at the floor, his hands clenched into fists 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Alright, Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚.

JACK:
(suddenly standing up, his eyes flashing with defiance)
No! I won't take it! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(calmly, but with a hint of annoyance)
Jack, you know it's for your own good. It's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕.

JACK:
(sneering)
You don't know what it's like to be me! You don't know what it's like to be trapped in this hellhole! 🔥

DR. SMITH:
(firmly)
Jack, I'm trying to help you. Now, please, just take the pills 📦.

JACK:
(standing up, his eyes blazing with anger)
No! I won't take them! You'll never make me take them! 💥

DR. SMITH:
(sighing, reluctantly)
Fine. If you won't take them, then I'll have to take them for you myself 💊.

Jack nods, a sly grin spreading across his face 😈.

DR. SMITH:
(opening his mouth to swallow the pills, but instead, he looks around the room, confused)

 Wait... where's Jack? 🤔

DR. SMITH:
(looking down at his hands, and then at his feet, and finally, at his reflection in a nearby mirror)

Oh no... I'm the one who's been pretending to be Jack all along 🤯.

The camera zooms out, revealing that Dr. Smith is standing alone in the empty room, the pills still clutched in his hand 💊.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
